title: cost-snapshot-toolbar-iterative-redlines-and-prototype-feedback
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective: Finalize the visual and interaction spec for the new Cost Snapshot toolbar that sits on each cost-insights card (desktop + compact mobile). Work includes redlines from stakeholders, an interactive Figma prototype for dev handoff, accessibility state definitions, and a QA checklist for engineering.

Scope:
- Toolbar actions: Pin snapshot, Share link (shortlink + copy), Export CSV, Time-range quick toggles, and Context menu (more actions).
- Microinteractions: hover, focus, pressed, and keyboard-only reveal behavior for compact mode.
- Motion: subtle entrance and affordance animations for toolbar reveal without shifting card layout.
- A11y: keyboard order, aria-labels, contrast for icon-only states, and screen reader announcement for exported artifacts.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Figma prototype (interactive) reflects final iconography, spacing, and motion timing and links to component tokens.
2) Redline PDF attached with pixel-level specs for padding, hit areas (minimum 44px), and color tokens.
3) Accessibility checklist completed with passes for contrast, focus ring, and keyboard-only discovery.
4) Handoff includes component token mapping and a short dev QA checklist with 8 test cases.
5) Engineering sign-off on feasibility and PR reference created before release branch window.

Out-of-scope: Global cost header redesign and backend export format changes (handled by ENG-78421).

qa_checklist: 1) Verify toolbar appears on hover and on keyboard focus without layout shift
2) Confirm each action (Pin, Share, Export, Time toggles, More) is reachable via Tab and triggers correct aria announcements
3) Export CSV produces properly encoded UTF-8 CSV and initiates download on desktop and mobile browsers
4) Share link copies a shortlink to clipboard and toast reads 'Link copied' (screen reader: assert announcement)
5) Hit areas meet 44px minimum across responsive breakpoints
6) Motion timing matches spec (reveal 160ms, fade 120ms) and can be disabled by 'reduce motion' media query
7) Color contrast of icon on hover meets 4.5:1 against background when in icon-only state
8) Confirm analytics attributes set on Share action (data-tag and snapshot-id present)
